tasks.label: Ensure Backend Running
args: $running = Test-NetConnection localhost -Port 3000 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; if (-not $running.TcpTestSucceeded) { Start-Process cmd.exe -ArgumentList '/k', 'npm run dev' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}\backend' -WindowStyle Minimized; $ready = $false; for ($i = 0; $i -lt 30; $i++) { Start-Sleep 1; if ((Test-NetConnection localhost -Port 3000 -WarningAction SilentlyContinue).TcpTestSucceeded) { $ready = $true; break } }; if (-not $ready) { throw 'Backend failed to start. Check backend terminal.' } }
